development.title: Development
development.text: Every film starts as an idea worth fighting for. We shape it into a story, a treatment and a plan that can be financed.

pre_production.title: Pre-production
pre_production.text: Casting, locations, crew and schedule: the film is made on paper before a single frame is shot.

production.title: Production
production.text: On set, with the camera rolling, and a crew that knows the story it is telling.

post_production.title: Post-production
post_production.text: Edit, colour, sound and effects turn the footage into the film.
post_production.deliverables: Edit · Colour grade · Sound mix · VFX

distribution.title: Distribution & Sales
distribution.text: Festivals, platforms and audiences: we take the finished film to the people it was made for.

film_graphics.title: Film Graphics
film_graphics.text: Titles, credits and on-screen type designed as part of the picture, not added on top.

poster_design.title: Poster Design
poster_design.text: One image that has to sell the whole film. We find it.

visual_identity.title: Visual Identity
visual_identity.text: Logo, type, colour and the rules that hold them together.

brand_strategy.title: Brand Strategy
brand_strategy.text: Who you are, who you speak to and why it matters, settled before anything is designed.

brand_storytelling.title: Brand Storytelling
brand_storytelling.text: The story behind the brand, told in words and images people remember.

advertising_films.title: Advertising Films
advertising_films.text: Commercials made with a filmmaker's eye, from script to final cut.

social_content.title: Social Content
social_content.text: Short, sharp content made for the feed and the format it lives in.

campaign_production.title: Campaign Production
campaign_production.text: One idea carried across film, stills and every channel it needs.

ai_production.title: AI Production
ai_production.text: Generative tools in a director's hands: new images, made fast and made well.
ai_production.deliverables: AI imagery · AI video · Hybrid shoots

photography.title: Photography
photography.text: Stills of products, people and places, lit and framed with intent.

ai_research.title: AI Research
ai_research.text: We test what new models can do for images and stories before it becomes common.

visual_experiments.title: Visual Experiments
visual_experiments.text: Looks, techniques and processes, tried for their own sake.

new_media.title: New Media
new_media.text: Work for screens and spaces that are still being invented.

creative_rnd.title: Creative R&D
creative_rnd.text: Research and development for ideas that need a new way to be made.

original_concepts.title: Original Concepts
original_concepts.text: Our own ideas, developed from a spark into formats and IP.

cta.title: Let's work together
cta.text: Tell us what you're making, and we'll take it from there.
